assumptions: Justin Tang played this team at the 2026 Pokémon World Championships under Regulation Set M-B, not M-C. It is used here as an M-C team because a third-party list (MetaVGC) shows all six Pokémon and all six items as legal in M-C and Pokémon.com says Pokémon eligible in earlier sets stay eligible. This is not confirmed from a Play! Pokémon rules document.
The practice four (Incineroar, Delphox, Blastoise, Sneasler) is this page's choice, not Tang's actual bring.
Scenarios use base forms. Mega Evolution is not simulated, although the team carries two Mega Stones and only one Pokémon can Mega Evolve per battle.
Opponents and their plans are hypothetical and scripted. Speed order is stated per scenario, not calculated, and no damage is simulated.
Move mechanics come from Pokémon Showdown data and Serebii's Champions attackdex. Bulbapedia could not be fetched, so it is not cited.
